description: Rules governing how an AI may use tokens in tokens/llm/token-catalog.json. Companion to component-allowlist.json (which closes WHAT may be set); this closes WHICH VALUES may be used.

rules.rule: Every color, type role, radius, shadow, spacing step, breakpoint, duration, easing and spring must be a catalog entry. Never introduce a new one.
Reference tokens by name; never write raw hex, px, rem, ms or cubic-bezier literals in generated output.
Prefer semantic roles over foundation colors wherever a semantic role exists.
dawn, desert, midnight and bone are decorative one-offs or unused and must not be used systemically (see semantic.json#notPromoted).
Use `white` rather than its alias `day`, except inside the Button day/heroSolid variants.
Every duration/easing/spring use must have a reducedMotionFallback (see motion/motion-spec.json).
Only the families in typography.json may be used; they are licensed, non-redistributable and must not be substituted with invented families.
Generated output may not modify, override or redefine any token value.
